speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa m nwanyị, gị na nwa nwa m ga-ezute ọtụtụ ndị okenye taa.
englishText: My daughter, you and my grandchild will meet many elders today.
statement: Dad says she and his grandchild will meet many elders today.
falseStatement: Dad says she and her grandson will meet many elders today.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks what they should do.
falseStatement: The daughter asks why they should do it.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mgbe i hụrụ nna ochie ma ọ bụ nne ochie, kele ha.
englishText: When you see a grandfather or grandmother, greet them.
statement: Dad says they should greet grandparents.
falseStatement: Dad says they should greet only grandfathers.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mgbe i hụrụ okenye nwoke ma ọ bụ okenye nwanyị, gosi nsọpụrụ.
englishText: When you see an old man or old woman, show respect.
statement: Dad says they should show respect to elders.
falseStatement: Dad says they should say hello to neighbors.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Kedu ka anyị ga-esi mee ya?
statement: The daughter asks how to do that.
falseStatement: The daughter asks when to do that.

speaker: dad
igboText: Gee ntị mgbe ha na-ekwu okwu.
statement: Dad says they should listen when elders speak.
falseStatement: Dad says they should talk when elders speak.

speaker: daughter
statement: The daughter asks what else they should do.
falseStatement: The daughter asks if they can leave.

speaker: dad
igboText: Unu abụọ ga-egbu ikpere mgbe unu na-ekele ha.
englishText: You both should kneel when greeting them.
statement: Dad says both of them should kneel when greeting elders.
falseStatement: Dad says only she should kneel when greeting them.

speaker: dad
igboText: N'ihi na nke ahụ bụ omenala anyị.
statement: Dad says it is their tradition.
falseStatement: Dad says it is their choice.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ndị okenye na-enye ngọzi, amamihe, na ndụmọdụ nye mmadụ niile.
englishText: Elders give blessings, wisdom, and advice to everyone.
statement: Dad says elders give blessings, wisdom, and advice to everyone.
falseStatement: Dad says elders give gifts, stories, and advice to everyone.
